en.help.body:
**prefix** — everything also works with `.` — try `.help` (change via /prefix)
**levels** — `/rank`
**mod** — `/mod`, `/clear`, `/banlist`, `/antiraid`, `/automod`
**roles** — `/selfroles`, level rewards handed out automatically

**voice** — join the lobby, your `pv` spawns with its panel in the room chat
